description: This file defines a data model class 'SampleDoc' for representing sample documents, along with a pre-populated list of sample documents. It serves as seed data for a documents library in an AI tutoring platform frontend.

classes.name: SampleDoc
classes.description: A data class representing a sample document with title, creation date, optional thumbnail, and optional summary.

methods.name: SampleDoc
methods.description: Constructor for creating immutable instances of SampleDoc with required fields 'title' and 'createdAt', and optional 'thumbnailPath' and 'summary'.
